summary: This article explains why countries set aside protected natural areas, the rules that keep wildlife and plants safe there, and how visitors can enjoy nature responsibly.
introduce: Write “Problem” and “Solution” on the board and give pairs thirty seconds to think of a problem people face in daily life and one way to fix it. Explain that as they read “National Parks: Protecting Wild Places”, they will look for the main problem and how it is solved.

keyTerms.def: to keep something safe from harm
the natural home where a plant or animal lives
wild animals living in their natural home

challengeTerms.def: the careful protection and management of nature and natural resources
all the living things and their environment in one area, working together
the wide variety of different plants, animals, and other living things in a place

discussion: Do you agree or disagree that every country should have more national parks? Use evidence from the article to explain.
Explain why national parks are important and one challenge they face.
struggling: Read the first part of the article aloud together, review protect, habitat, and wildlife, and let weak readers fill in a simple Problem | Solution chart with sentence starters.
gifted: Challenge advanced readers to use conservation, ecosystem, and biodiversity in a short paragraph that suggests a second solution to the problem and judge which works better.
